We're reviewing the March invoice (INV-2027-03-4532) and our finance team flagged a ~10x increase in billed tokens compared to February ($12,940 vs ~$1,200). We've looked at our app logs and don't see corresponding user activity.

Specific asks:
- Can you provide per-request/session-level evidence for the ~2027-03-22 to 2027-03-24 window?
- Was there a sampling or attenuation change on your side that could cause higher token counts?
- Please confirm whether internal/staging API keys from our account could have been counted against production billing.

We need the exports and a short summary to present to our accounting team by end of week. We'd like to request a temporary hold on collection for this invoice until the root cause is confirmed.

Thanks,

Hi all — I pulled the per-request export and did an initial pass. Summary: there's a concentrated burst on 2027-03-23 02:10–02:34 UTC from ~4500 requests tied to a small set of session IDs. The token distribution for those requests is unusually high (avg 2,800 tokens/request) and the user_agent string on those lines indicates a background ingest/replay job ("SweetStream/1.2-replay").

What I attached/provided:
- usage-export-20270417.csv (excerpt with top 500 rows for the window)
- billing-snapshot-20270417.json (aggregated ledger rows)
- session-traces-20270417.zip (3 sample traces)

Notes on attenuation: we did a change to the continuous-batching heuristics earlier in March, but that change targets long KV-caching paths and would not increase tokens per request like this — it would reduce token counts for repeat prefixes. The traces strongly suggest a replay job generated unusually large prompts (not an attenuation policy issue).

Next steps I recommend:
1) StellarData: confirm whether any internal automation or QA replay job ran on 2027-03-23 that might match the traces.
2) If confirmed replay/staging keys: we can calculate a credit for the exact affected token range (Ben, I'll send the affected token totals per session).
3) If you don't have a matching replay, we can provide a fuller export (full window) and run a pointer-trace against the request IDs.

Link to full export (restricted): https://redwood.app/usage-exports/SD-3981/20270417 (expires 7 days)

— Neha Kapoor
Senior SRE, Metering & Telemetry | Redwood Inference
